name: Elisur
title: Leader of the tribe of Reuben
summary: Elisur, son of Shedeur, was the chosen leader and chief of the tribe of Reuben during the wilderness journey. He represented his tribe at the census and at the dedication of the tabernacle, and was one of the twelve tribal princes who assisted Moses in organizing the people of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Leader of the Tribe of Reuben
keyEvents.description: Elisur, son of Shedeur, was appointed by God as leader and representative of the tribe of Reuben to assist Moses in the census.

keyEvents.title: The Census in the Wilderness
keyEvents.description: Elisur led the counting of fighting men from the tribe of Reuben, which totaled 46,500 men over twenty years old.

keyEvents.title: Camp Arrangement Around the Tabernacle
keyEvents.description: Elisur was appointed leader of the camp of Reuben on the south side of the tabernacle, along with the tribes of Simeon and Gad.

keyEvents.title: Offering at the Dedication of the Altar
keyEvents.description: On the second day of the dedication of the tabernacle, Elisur brought his offering: a silver plate, a silver basin, a gold spoon, a burnt offering, and a sin offering.

keyEvents.title: Leader of Reuben's Division in the March Order
keyEvents.description: Elisur, son of Shedeur, led the army of the tribe of Reuben when the people of Israel broke camp and marched through the wilderness.
